_comment: Filtering profiles: the defaults a site starts with. state.json "profiles" replaces this list once edited in Photosphere (Networks → Filtering profiles). Names are ids (devices and networks refer to them); labels are what people see.

settings.global: Use AdGuard's own global settings instead of the switches below
settings.filtering: Block ads, trackers and anything on your block lists
settings.safeBrowsing: Block known malware and phishing sites
settings.safeSearch: Force Safe Search on Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and others
settings.blockedServices: Whole services to block (games, social media, streaming…)

defaults.name: admin
defaults.label: Unfiltered
defaults.desc: No filtering. For your own devices and servers.

defaults.name: adult
defaults.label: Standard
defaults.desc: Blocks ads, trackers and malware. No content limits.

defaults.name: kid
defaults.label: Kids
defaults.desc: Adds adult-content blocking, Safe Search and YouTube Restricted Mode.

defaults.name: default
defaults.label: AdGuard defaults
defaults.desc: Whatever AdGuard's global settings say — what unknown devices get unless their network sets a default.
